isaac_7d_semantics.description: Isaac reaching-pose action space in robot base frame
isaac_7d_semantics.translation_units: meters (increment per control tick in robot base frame)
isaac_7d_semantics.gripper_representation: binary discrete state (+1.0 closed <= 0.02m finger opening, -1.0 open)

mimic_10d_semantics.rotation_representation: 6D continuous rotation representation (first two rows of 3x3 rotation matrix, flattened row-major)

mapping_formulas.7d_to_10d: rot_matrix = Rotation.from_rotvec(action_7d[..., 3:6]).as_matrix(); rot6 = rot_matrix[..., :2, :].reshape(..., 6); action_10d = concat([action_7d[..., :3], rot6, action_7d[..., 6:7]], axis=-1)
mapping_formulas.10d_to_7d: first = normalize(rot6[..., 0:3]); second = normalize(rot6[..., 3:6] - first * dot(first, rot6[..., 3:6])); third = cross(first, second); rot_matrix = stack([first, second, third], axis=-2); rotvec = Rotation.from_matrix(rot_matrix).as_rotvec(); action_7d = concat([action_10d[..., :3], rotvec, action_10d[..., 9:10]], axis=-1)
